### Saga states / melt-Unknown reconciliation
Reuses the existing `WalletOperationState` set unchanged (Draft→Prepared→MintPending→MintSettled→PublishPending→Settled, plus Unknown/Failed) under a new `WalletOperationKind::CrossMintTransfer`. Melt is the irreversible leg: consumed source inputs + `melt_quote_id` are journaled before the melt HTTP call; a non-`PAID` or transport-failed melt goes `Unknown` and is reconciled **only** via `get_melt_quote_status` on a cold-restart `ResumeCrossMintTransferCommand` (never assumed, never a live retry loop) — `PAID` restores nothing and proceeds to mint, `UNPAID`/expired restores the reserved source proofs and fails closed. Target `mint_tokens` is write-if-absent fenced (mirrors `PendingDeposit::minted_proofs`, #2946) so a resume never double-mints. Melt is the irreversible leg: consumed source inputs + `melt_quote_id` are journaled before the melt HTTP call; a non-`PAID` or transport-failed melt goes `Unknown` and is reconciled **only** via `get_melt_quote_status` on a cold-restart `ResumeCrossMintTransferCommand` (never assumed, never a live retry loop) — `PAID` restores nothing and proceeds to mint, `UNPAID`/expired restores the reserved source proofs and fails closed. Target `mint_tokens` is write-if-absent fenced (mirrors `PendingDeposit::minted_proofs`, #2946) so a resume never double-mints. [...] **1. Multi-source melt** — the saga now loops candidate source mints (largest-first, no hardcoded fake-mint detection). testnut's melt confirms unpaid → it moves on to chorus/flashapp automatically. The one hard rule baked in: it advances to the next source **only** on positive confirmation the current one didn't pay (definite-unpaid, or a `get_melt_quote_status` recheck saying unpaid) — never on an ambiguous melt, because a possibly-paid source plus a second melt would double-spend. That ambiguous case stays `Unknown` and reconciles from the WAL on restart, which now can also advance sources.
